tasks.label: Find local preview process
tasks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'next dev' } | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine | Format-List

tasks.label: Find current dev server PID
tasks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'next dev' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CommandLine | Format-List

tasks.label: Check Supabase connectivity without exposing keys
args: const fs=require('fs');const raw=fs.readFileSync('.env.local','utf8');const env=Object.fromEntries(raw.split(/\r?\n/).filter(x=>x&& !x.trim().startsWith('#')).map(x=>{const i=x.indexOf('=');return [x.slice(0,i).trim(),x.slice(i+1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g,'')]}));const url=env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;const key=env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY||env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;if(!url||!key){console.log(JSON.stringify({configured:false,hasProjectUrl:!!url,hasPublishableKey:!!key}));process.exit(0)};(async()=>{const names=['teams','team_members','submissions','submission_files','admin_users','event_settings','evaluation_batches','evaluation_jobs','evaluation_evidence','ai_evaluations','evaluation_criteria','leaderboards','shortlisted_teams','audit_logs'];const results=await Promise.all(names.map(async table=>{try{const r=await fetch(url+'/rest/v1/'+table+'?select=*&limit=0',{headers:{apikey:key,Authorization:'Bearer '+key,Accept:'application/json'}});return {table,status:r.status,exists:r.status!==404}}catch(e){return {table,error:String(e)}}}));console.log(JSON.stringify({configured:true,baseUrlHost:new URL(url).host,tables:results},null,2))})()

tasks.label: Check Supabase CLI login
tasks.command: $cli = Get-Command supabase -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($cli) { Write-Output 'Supabase CLI available'; supabase --version; supabase projects list --output json | ConvertFrom-Json | ForEach-Object { $_.projects | ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ ref = $_.id; name = $_.name } } } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } else { Write-Output 'Supabase CLI is not installed or not on PATH' }

tasks.label: Inspect configured secret names only
tasks.command: $keys = Get-Content .env.local | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s*=' } | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '=',2)[0].Trim() }; [PSCustomObject]@{ LocalEnvKeys = ($keys -join ', '); SupabaseAccessTokenInProcess = [bool]$env:SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN; SupabaseCliSessionAvailable = (Test-Path (Join-Path $HOME '.supabase\access-token')) } | Format-List
